title: OpenSSLContext Mutual Auth Not Returning Acceptable CAs
body:
### Expected behavior
Openssl provider should behave same as JDK provider when mutual authentication is required and a specific set of trusted Certificate Authorities are specified.  The SSL handshake should return back to the connected peer the same list of configured Certificate Authorities.

```java
SslContext ctx = SslContextBuilder.forServer(APP_CERT, APP_KEY)
    .trustManager(TRUST_CA).sslProvider(SslProvider.JDK)
    .clientAuth(ClientAuth.REQUIRE).build();
```

```bash
$> openssl s_client -connect localhost:8443 -cert app.crt -key app.key -CAfile rootCA.pem -tls1

CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=1 /C=US/ST=VA/O=MyCompany/CN=TestCA
verify return:1
depth=0 /C=US/ST=VA/O=MyCompany/CN=application.com
verify return:1
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/C=US/ST=VA/O=MyCompany/CN=application.com
   i:/C=US/ST=VA/O=MyCompany/CN=TestCA
---
Server certificate
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
MIIDAzCCAesCCQCRNC2p+O2dkjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQsFADA/MQswCQYDVQQGEwJV
...
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
subject=/C=US/ST=VA/O=MyCompany/CN=application.com
issuer=/C=US/ST=VA/O=MyCompany/CN=TestCA
---
Acceptable client certificate CA names
/C=US/ST=VA/O=MyCompany/CN=TestCA
---
SSL handshake has read 1011 bytes and written 2421 bytes
---
New, TLSv1/SSLv3, Cipher is AES128-SHA
Server public key is 2048 bit
Secure Renegotiation IS supported
Compression: NONE
Expansion: NONE
SSL-Session:
    Protocol  : TLSv1
    Cipher    : AES128-SHA
    Session-ID: 5855B84CFD30126A45C3E9E4D54AE560DDFE8248DE82EB163823BB80CC10400C
    Session-ID-ctx: 
    Master-Key: A5296BB5726865BC8350D7DC286ED5472B6ACE3C404462779BDAAD114A54AB64109D965E154076112E9279611F1390D6
    Key-Arg   : None
    Start Time: 1482012748
    Timeout   : 7200 (sec)
    Verify return code: 0 (ok)
---

```
 
### Actual behavior
Openssl provider does not return a list of acceptable Certificate Authorities during SSL handshake.

```java
SslContext ctx = SslContextBuilder.forServer(APP_CERT, APP_KEY)
    .trustManager(TRUST_CA).sslProvider(SslProvider.OPENSSL)
    .clientAuth(ClientAuth.REQUIRE).build();
```

```bash
$> openssl s_client -connect localhost:8443 -cert app.crt -key app.key -CAfile rootCA.pem -tls1
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=1 /C=US/ST=VA/O=MyCompany/CN=TestCA
verify return:1
depth=0 /C=US/ST=VA/O=MyCompany/CN=application.com
verify return:1
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/C=US/ST=VA/O=MyCompany/CN=application.com
   i:/C=US/ST=VA/O=MyCompany/CN=TestCA
---
Server certificate
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
MIIDAzCCAesCCQCRNC2p+O2dkjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQsFADA/MQswCQYDVQQGEwJV
...
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
subject=/C=US/ST=VA/O=MyCompany/CN=application.com
issuer=/C=US/ST=VA/O=MyCompany/CN=TestCA
---
No client certificate CA names sent
---
SSL handshake has read 954 bytes and written 2421 bytes
---
New, TLSv1/SSLv3, Cipher is AES128-SHA
Server public key is 2048 bit
Secure Renegotiation IS supported
Compression: NONE
Expansion: NONE
SSL-Session:
    Protocol  : TLSv1
    Cipher    : AES128-SHA
    Session-ID: 04CD85C7E4F5F0431C1998B82EA69874BC417060C5AA2C540DDC2003D507F58E
    Session-ID-ctx: 
    Master-Key: A2E1A0E2BA8CFC4B45B20940BCC46DAC35A731E850B93F2F207A872D32B298E3C8CBE63427C2CF242D1470A905C562CA
    Key-Arg   : None
    Start Time: 1482013114
    Timeout   : 7200 (sec)
    Verify return code: 0 (ok)
---
```

### Steps to reproduce
1. launch [MutualSSLAuthServer](https://gist.github.com/bm3780/0fe9b73a32dfcd7b940054409c77e607) with `JDK` parameter
```bash
   $> java SSLMutualAuthServer JDK
```

2. connect to server and notice the list of client certificate CA names
```bash
   $> openssl s_client -connect localhost:8443 -cert app.crt -key app.key -CAfile rootCA.pem -tls1
...
Acceptable client certificate CA names
/C=US/ST=VA/O=MyCompany/CN=TestCA
...
```

3. next, re-launch MutualSSLAuthServer with `OPENSSL` paramater
 ```bash
   $> java SSLMutualAuthServer OPENSSL
```

4. connect to server and notice the list of client certificate CA names
```bash
   $> openssl s_client -connect localhost:8443 -cert app.crt -key app.key -CAfile rootCA.pem -tls1
...
No client certificate CA names sent
...
```

### Minimal yet complete reproducer code (or URL to code)
[MutualSSLAuthServer](https://gist.github.com/bm3780/0fe9b73a32dfcd7b940054409c77e607) 
[app.key](https://gist.github.com/bm3780/a9065d7e704a51a3aa012c3569778a78)
[app.crt](https://gist.github.com/bm3780/2ed555d3e8815f375d9d20e0603761b0)
[rootCA.pem](https://gist.github.com/bm3780/37bf4a12c3a336a51bab8d70f66768a5)

### Netty version
4.0.42.Final

### JVM version (e.g. `java -version`)
1.8

### OS version (e.g. `uname -a`)
Mac, CentOS6
